rationale: New Binance USD-M perpetuals list at peak attention with a small float, airdrop/early-investor supply and upcoming unlocks. Hypothesis: prices drift down over the following weeks by more than costs and funding paid by shorts.

universe.source: every USDT-margined symbol with a Binance USD-M monthly kline archive (bucket listing), including later-delisted symbols
universe.exclusions: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, stablecoin/commodity bases, index symbols
universe.listing_date: timestamp of the first daily bar in the archives
universe.known_contamination: ticker migrations/re-denominations (e.g. MATIC->POL, 1000x re-lists) appear as listings; kept, reported as a limitation

S115_A.entry: short at the open of the 2nd daily bar (first bar may be partial)
S115_A.exit: close of the 14th daily bar after entry (entry bar = day 1)
S115_A.stop: +35% above entry, checked on daily highs; fill at max(stop, bar open) plus slippage

S115_B.entry: short at the open of the 4th daily bar (skips the first three days)
S115_B.exit: close of the 30th daily bar after entry

delisting: if data ends before the planned exit, exit at the last available close

costs.funding: actual settled funding over [entry, exit); short receives positive rates and pays negative rates

sizing_for_usd: fixed $25 notional per listing (10% of $250, 1x); concurrency reported
gates_all_required: stress mean net return per trade > 0 with month-block bootstrap 97.5% lower bound > 0 (Bonferroni for 2 hypotheses)
stress mean net return > 0 in every calendar year 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026
BTC-hedged stress mean net return > 0 (excludes a pure alt-beta bear-market effect)
no_parameter_search: exactly two pre-registered variants; any change requires a new protocol id
